::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Bengaluru (Whitefield) mm-wave firm founded 2014, now described by Sansera Engineering as a group company. Its June 2024 facility (US$4M outlay) adds packaging, assembly and test to R&D. No public confirmation yet that the DLI Ka-band beamformer chip has taped out.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Millimetre-wave chips and subsystems for radar, 5G/6G communications and wireless connectivity.

**Why these scores**

- **Domain difficulty 5/5:** Millimetre-wave GaAs/GaN MMICs and front-ends for radar and 5G/6G.
- **IP ownership 3/5:** Mix of own MMICs and subsystems; the entry does not separate own from bought-in IP.
- **Design completeness 2/5:** No public confirmation that the DLI Ka-band beamformer has taped out.
- **Market readiness 3/5:** Sells chips and subsystems, with packaging and test in its 2024 facility.
